cards.example_en: Only one vacant seat remained beside the window on the bus.
cards.example_zh: 公共汽车上靠窗的位置只剩一个空座。

cards.example_en: His vague answer left the whole group unsure about the real plan.
cards.example_zh: 他含糊其词的回答让全组的人都弄不清真正的计划。

cards.example_en: All their efforts to save the ancient tree proved to be in vain.
cards.example_zh: 他们拯救那棵古树的一切努力最终都白费了。

cards.example_en: Your student card is valid until the end of June.
cards.example_zh: 你的学生卡到六月底都有效。

cards.example_en: Please draw a vertical line through the exact center of the circle.
cards.example_zh: 请画一条穿过圆心的垂直线。

cards.example_en: We flew from London to Sydney via Dubai and arrived very late.
cards.example_zh: 我们从伦敦经由迪拜飞往悉尼，到达时已经很晚了。

cards.example_en: Smoking slowly became a vice he found difficult to give up.
cards.example_zh: 吸烟渐渐成了他难以戒掉的恶习。

cards.example_en: Grandma uses a videophone so she can see our faces while we talk.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶使用可视电话，这样说话时她能看见我们的脸。

cards.example_en: Add one spoonful of vinegar to the soup if you want a brighter taste.
cards.example_zh: 如果想让味道更鲜，就往汤里加一勺醋。

cards.example_en: Cyclists who violate the red light put other road users at risk.
cards.example_zh: 闯红灯的骑行者会危及其他道路使用者。

cards.example_en: A violent coastal storm tore several roofs off houses near the harbour.
cards.example_zh: 一场猛烈的沿海风暴掀掉了港口附近几座房屋的屋顶。

cards.example_en: She waited nearly three weeks for her student visa before travelling.
cards.example_zh: 她等了将近三周才拿到学生签证，然后才动身。

cards.example_en: Their voyage across the rough Atlantic took nearly two weeks.
cards.example_zh: 他们横渡波涛汹涌的大西洋，航行了将近两周。

cards.example_en: The little dog began to wag its tail as soon as it saw her.
cards.example_zh: 那只小狗一看见她就开始摇尾巴。

cards.example_en: Patients sat quietly in the waiting-room until a nurse called their names.
cards.example_zh: 病人们安静地坐在候诊室里，直到护士叫到他们的名字。

cards.example_en: She cracked a fresh walnut and scattered the pieces over the salad.
cards.example_zh: 她敲开一颗新鲜核桃，把碎仁撒在沙拉上。

cards.example_en: Hundreds of boxed books were stored in a warehouse beside the river.
cards.example_zh: 数百箱图书存放在河边的一座仓库里。

cards.example_en: The warmth of the kitchen fire soon dried our wet coats.
cards.example_zh: 厨房炉火的温暖很快烘干了我们的湿外套。

cards.example_en: Honeybees use wax to build the tiny cells inside their hive.
cards.example_zh: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢里小小的巢室。

cards.example_en: The wide river flows westward until it finally reaches the sea.
cards.example_zh: 这条宽阔的河流向西奔去，直到最终入海。

cards.example_en: The referee will whistle twice when the second half is about to start.
cards.example_zh: 下半场即将开始时，裁判会吹两声哨。

cards.example_en: The elderly widow lived alone in a small house beside the church.
cards.example_zh: 这位年迈的寡妇独自住在教堂旁边的一所小房子里。

cards.example_en: Please wipe the muddy shoes before you step onto the clean carpet.
cards.example_zh: 踏上干净的地毯之前，请先把沾泥的鞋擦一擦。

cards.example_en: A worldwide shortage of grain pushed bread prices much higher.
cards.example_zh: 全球性的粮食短缺把面包价格推高了许多。

cards.example_en: Excited fans yell the player's name each time he scores a goal.
cards.example_zh: 每当那名球员进球，兴奋的球迷就大声喊他的名字。

cards.example_en: The tomato soup smells yummy, and the children can hardly wait.
cards.example_zh: 番茄汤闻起来真香，孩子们都快等不及了。

cards.example_en: The zipper on my winter jacket stuck halfway and refused to move.
cards.example_zh: 我冬季夹克上的拉链卡在半道，怎么也拉不动。

cards.example_en: Fast cars zoom past our kitchen window every morning at rush hour.
cards.example_zh: 每天早晨的高峰时段，汽车从我们厨房的窗前疾驰而过。

word.example_en: They searched in vain for the ticket.
word.example_zh: 他们找那张票，白费了力气。

word.example_en: One wrong click can wipe out a file.
word.example_zh: 点错一次就可能彻底清除一个文件。
